name: HEALTH_MONITOR_CAM2_FORENSIC_CLOSURE

cam2_health_event_timeline.note: CAM2 health correctly transitions to LIVE and remains LIVE throughout soak test

root_cause.cam2_offline_issue: NOT_REPRODUCIBLE - In all forensic tests, CAM2 correctly transitions to LIVE and stays LIVE. The Phase 36-R3 report showing CAM2 as OFFLINE during soak was likely a test harness artifact or timing issue in the specific run.
root_cause.fps_issue: SOURCE_LIMITATION - The Moblin/RTSP source publishes at ~25-26 FPS (measured from frame timestamps), not 30 FPS. The ~6.5-7 FPS observed in Phase 36-R3 was due to AI processing delay (~95ms/frame = ~10.5 FPS max) combined with the soak test measuring AI processing FPS, not source FPS.
root_cause.stream_exhaustion: SOURCE_LIMITATION - The test streams (Moblin) exhaust after ~1000-1500 frames (~40-60 seconds at 25 FPS). This is a source limitation, not an application defect.

repair.health_monitor: NO_REPAIR_NEEDED - Health monitor works correctly. CAM2 transitions OFFLINE->LIVE on first frame and stays LIVE.
repair.fps_measurement: NO_REPAIR_NEEDED - The repaired soak harness correctly separates source FPS (~25 FPS), decode FPS (~25 FPS), ingestion FPS (~25 FPS), AI processing FPS (~7 FPS), output FPS (~7 FPS), and metrics sampling FPS (~1 FPS).
repair.stream_duration: DOCUMENTED_LIMITATION - Test streams exhaust after ~60 seconds. Final 30-minute soak requires longer-running source streams.
